name: python_external3.k
model:
import python math

class PythagoreanPython {
  a:Real
  b:Real
  c:Real

  req a = 3E0

  req b = 4E0

  req c = math.sqrt(math.pow(a,2E0) + math.pow(b,2E0))

  req c = 5E0
}

main:PythagoreanPython
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((PythagoreanPython (mk-PythagoreanPython (a Real)(b Real)(c Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-PythagoreanPython (sel-PythagoreanPython PythagoreanPython))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-PythagoreanPython ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-PythagoreanPython (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-PythagoreanPython ((this Ref)) PythagoreanPython
  (sel-PythagoreanPython (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-PythagoreanPython ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-PythagoreanPython this)
)

; =======================================
; === External Function Declarations: ===
; =======================================

; Uninterpreted functions for external (Java) calls
(declare-fun py_math_sqrt (Real) Real)
(declare-fun py_math_pow (Real Real) Real)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class PythagoreanPython:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for PythagoreanPython.a: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython!a ((this Ref)) Real
  (a (deref-PythagoreanPython this))
)

; --- getters for PythagoreanPython.b: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython!b ((this Ref)) Real
  (b (deref-PythagoreanPython this))
)

; --- getters for PythagoreanPython.c: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython!c ((this Ref)) Real
  (c (deref-PythagoreanPython this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-PythagoreanPython (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class PythagoreanPython:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-PythagoreanPython PythagoreanPython)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (PythagoreanPython!a this) 3.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (PythagoreanPython.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (PythagoreanPython!b this) 4.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (PythagoreanPython.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (PythagoreanPython!c this) (py_math_sqrt (+ (py_math_pow (PythagoreanPython!a this) 2.0000000000000000) (py_math_pow (PythagoreanPython!b this) 2.0000000000000000))))
)

(assert (! (PythagoreanPython.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun PythagoreanPython.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (PythagoreanPython!c this) 5.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (PythagoreanPython.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-PythagoreanPython const-1-PythagoreanPython))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-PythagoreanPython () PythagoreanPython
  (mk-PythagoreanPython 3.0 4.0 5.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (b (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) 4.0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (py_math_pow (a (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) 2.0))
      (a!2 (py_math_pow (b (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) 2.0)))
  (= (c (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) (py_math_sqrt (+ a!1 a!2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-PythagoreanPython a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) 3.0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (c (sel-PythagoreanPython (select heap 1))) 5.0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-PythagoreanPython (mk-PythagoreanPython 3.0 4.0 5.0))))
(define-fun py_math_pow ((x!0 Real) (x!1 Real)) Real
  0.0)
(define-fun py_math_sqrt ((x!0 Real)) Real
  5.0)
